topics.purpose: Define the explicit transition from marketplace opportunity/listing to a canonical Project, preserving listing provenance without making the listing itself the work primitive.

semantics.transition_rule: Accepted opportunity creates or binds to an explicit Project.
semantics.identity_rule: Resulting Project has its own stable Project identity.
semantics.provenance_rule: Project may retain source listing/opportunity refs.
semantics.scope_rule: Agreed work scope is Project semantics after creation.
semantics.listing_rule: Listing may close/remain historical after Project creation.
semantics.causality_rule: Listing -> acceptance -> Project creation is explicit mechanism causality, not inferred from relation proximity.

invariants.rule: Marketplace discovery, matching, participation, feedback and visibility semantics remain explicit and do not override Project/Merit/IAM ownership.

hard_gates.condition: accepted listing used as Project identity directly without explicit Project definition
Project creation provenance to opportunity lost
work begins without explicit Project where Project model applies
listing and Project semantics duplicated inconsistently
transition causality inferred rather than explicit
